This page gives a collection of all characters whose occupation may be listed as a [[Healer]]. This encompasses many different names in different lands, such as Wise Women, Wisdoms, hedgedoctors and others.

This category excludes those that belong to the [[Yellow Ajah]], who have their own [[:Category:Yellow Ajah|page]].
